==Notes==
*Obrhit Barkwood has five possible spawn locations in the [[Frozen Forest]], which it shares with four other [[Pinesoul]] bosses - [[Afrhul Deeproot]], [[Arkhel Havenwood]], [[Esnhal Hardwood]], and [[Unthet Rotwood]].
*Every [[Pinesoul]] boss is accompanied by 3 [[Ice Imp]]s.
*Sometimes one of these bosses doesn't even spawn at all.
